summary: VNET Group, Inc. announced the closing of a previously announced strategic investment on September 21, 2026. PJ Millennium I and II Limited (Buyers) acquired an aggregate of 650,424,192 Class A ordinary shares from Success Flow International Investment Limited and Choice Faith Group Holdings Limited (Sellers). Following the closing, the Buyers collectively hold approximately 38.1% of VNET's total issued and outstanding ordinary shares, based on 1,708,970,760 ordinary shares outstanding as of June 30, 2026. In connection with the closing, an investor rights agreement and a voting and consortium agreement among the Buyers and Mr. Josh Sheng Chen became effective. The filing does not disclose the purchase price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor.
